title: HSK 3.12 · 相关, 评价, 性格, 退休, 工厂
focus: 千万 · 钟 · 接近 · 持续 · 和平 · 修 · 相关 · 价格 · 旧 · 简直 · 退 · 交流 · 付 · 升 · 互相 · 评价 · 资格 · 连续 · 厂 · 相互 · 工资 · 个性 · 批准 · 工厂 · 指出 · 看上去 · 退出 · 支付 · 上升 · 相比 · 歌手 · 性格 · 主持 · 手指 · 工业 · 广播 · 直播 · 交往 · 退休 · 批评
body:
Work and evaluation vocabulary. 相 *mutual*, 工 *work*, 退 *retreat*, 格 *standard, grid* and 指 *finger, point* repeat, and several pairs mirror each other (互相 / 相互, 手指 / 指出, 性格 / 个性).

## Characters that repeat

| Character | Pinyin | Meaning | In this lesson |
|---|---|---|---|
| 相 | xiāng | mutual, each other | 相关, 互相, 相互, 相比 |
| 工 | gōng | work | 工资, 工厂, 工业 |
| 退 | tuì | retreat (辶 walk) | 退, 退出, 退休 |
| 格 | gé | grid, standard (木 wood) | 价格, 资格, 性格 |
| 价 | jià | price, value | 价格, 评价 |
| 续 | xù | continue (纟 thread) | 持续, 连续 |
| 评 | píng | judge (讠 speech) | 评价, 批评 |
| 播 | bō | broadcast, sow (扌 hand) | 广播, 直播 |

## Watch out

- 互相 and 相互 mean the same thing: "each other".
- 看上去 ends in neutral tones: kàn shangqu.
- 厂 (chǎng, factory) is also the "cliff" radical in 历, 压. 广 (guǎng) has an extra dot on top.

cards.Meaning: by all means, must; ten million
cards.Example: 千万别忘了！ qiānwàn bié wàng le: Whatever you do, don't forget!
cards.Notes: 千 thousand + 万 ten thousand = countless times over, so "absolutely"

cards.Example: 现在三点钟。 xiànzài sān diǎn zhōng: It's three o'clock
cards.Notes: 钅 metal + 中 zhōng for the sound = metal bell, clock

cards.Example: 他的中文接近完美。 tā de Zhōngwén jiējìn wánměi: His Chinese is near perfect
cards.Notes: 接 connect (扌 hand) + 近 near (辶 walk + 斤 jīn sound) = come into contact, near

cards.Example: 大雨持续了三天。 dàyǔ chíxù le sān tiān: The rain lasted three days
cards.Notes: 持 hold (扌 hand + 寺 sì sound) + 续 continue (纟 thread) = keep holding on

cards.Example: 我们都爱和平。 wǒmen dōu ài hépíng: We all love peace
cards.Notes: 和 harmony + 平 level, calm = harmony and calm, peace

cards.Example: 我去修手机。 wǒ qù xiū shǒujī: I'm getting my phone fixed
cards.Notes: 亻 person + 丨 + 攵 action + 彡 decorative strokes = tidy up, mend

cards.Example: 相关的书在这里。 xiāngguān de shū zài zhèli: The related books are here
cards.Notes: 相 mutual + 关 connection = mutually connected

cards.Example: 价格太高了。 jiàgé tài gāo le: The price is too high
cards.Notes: 价 price (亻 + 介 jiè sound) + 格 standard = price standard, price

cards.Example: 这件衣服很旧。 zhè jiàn yīfu hěn jiù: This shirt is old
cards.Notes: 丨 + 日; simplified form, the parts don't give the meaning. Opposite: 新. For people, use 老

cards.Example: 简直太好了！ jiǎnzhí tài hǎo le: That's simply great!
cards.Notes: 简 simple (⺮ bamboo) + 直 straight = simply and directly, "just plain"

cards.Example: 我想退这件衣服。 wǒ xiǎng tuì zhè jiàn yīfu: I want to return this shirt
cards.Notes: 辶 walk + 艮 (gèn) = walk back, retreat. Lookalike: 很, 跟 share 艮

cards.Example: 我们多交流吧。 wǒmen duō jiāoliú ba: Let's talk more
cards.Notes: 交 exchange + 流 flow (氵 water) = let ideas flow back and forth

cards.Example: 我来付钱。 wǒ lái fù qián: I'll pay
cards.Notes: 亻 person + 寸 hand = hand something to a person, pay

cards.Example: 太阳升起来了。 tàiyáng shēng qǐlai le: The sun has risen
cards.Notes: Picture of a ladle or measure, borrowed for "rise". Lookalike: 开 kāi, 井 jǐng

cards.Example: 我们互相帮助。 wǒmen hùxiāng bāngzhù: We help each other
cards.Notes: 互 mutual + 相 each other = mutually

cards.Example: 大家评价很高。 dàjiā píngjià hěn gāo: People rate it highly
cards.Notes: 评 judge (讠 speech + 平 píng sound) + 价 value = judge the value

cards.Example: 他没有资格参加。 tā méiyǒu zīgé cānjiā: He isn't qualified to join
cards.Notes: 资 resources (贝 money + 次 cì sound) + 格 standard = meet the standard

cards.Example: 他连续工作十天。 tā liánxù gōngzuò shí tiān: He worked ten days straight
cards.Notes: 连 link + 续 continue = linked and continuing, in a row

cards.Example: 他在厂里上班。 tā zài chǎng li shàngbān: He works at the factory
cards.Notes: Picture of a cliff overhang (also the radical in 历, 压). Lookalike: 广 guǎng has a dot

cards.Example: 他们相互了解。 tāmen xiānghù liǎojiě: They understand each other
cards.Notes: 相 each other + 互 mutual = mutual. Same as 互相

cards.Example: 我的工资不高。 wǒ de gōngzī bù gāo: My salary isn't high
cards.Notes: 工 work + 资 money, resources (贝 shell = money) = money for work

cards.Example: 她很有个性。 tā hěn yǒu gèxìng: She has a lot of character
cards.Notes: 个 individual + 性 nature (忄 heart + 生 shēng sound) = individual nature

cards.Example: 老板批准了。 lǎobǎn pīzhǔn le: The boss approved it
cards.Notes: 批 comment on (扌 hand + 比 bǐ sound) + 准 allow = mark it as allowed

cards.Example: 这个工厂很大。 zhège gōngchǎng hěn dà: This factory is big
cards.Notes: 工 work + 厂 factory = workplace, factory

cards.Example: 他指出了问题。 tā zhǐchū le wèntí: He pointed out the problem
cards.Notes: 指 finger, point (扌 hand + 旨 zhǐ sound) + 出 out = point it out

cards.Example: 你看上去很累。 nǐ kànshangqu hěn lèi: You look tired
cards.Notes: 看 look + 上 up + 去 go = as it looks to the eye, seems

cards.Example: 我退出了比赛。 wǒ tuìchū le bǐsài: I withdrew from the competition
cards.Notes: 退 retreat + 出 out = back out

cards.Example: 可以用手机支付。 kěyǐ yòng shǒujī zhīfù: You can pay by phone
cards.Notes: 支 pay out, support + 付 pay = pay out

cards.Example: 气温上升了。 qìwēn shàngshēng le: The temperature went up
cards.Notes: 上 up + 升 rise = rise upward

cards.Example: 和去年相比，好多了。 hé qùnián xiāngbǐ, hǎo duō le: It's much better than last year
cards.Notes: 相 each other + 比 compare = compare side by side

cards.Example: 她是有名的歌手。 tā shì yǒumíng de gēshǒu: She's a famous singer
cards.Notes: 歌 song + 手 hand, skilled person = song person, singer

cards.Example: 他性格很好。 tā xìnggé hěn hǎo: He has a nice personality
cards.Notes: 性 nature + 格 pattern = pattern of one's nature

cards.Example: 今天谁主持？ jīntiān shéi zhǔchí: Who's hosting today?
cards.Notes: 主 master + 持 hold = hold the main role, host

cards.Example: 我的手指疼。 wǒ de shǒuzhǐ téng: My finger hurts
cards.Notes: 手 hand + 指 finger = finger

cards.Example: 这里工业很发达。 zhèli gōngyè hěn fādá: Industry here is developed
cards.Notes: 工 work + 业 trade, business = work trades, industry

cards.Example: 我在听广播。 wǒ zài tīng guǎngbō: I'm listening to the radio
cards.Notes: 广 wide + 播 spread (扌 hand + 番 fān sound) = spread widely

cards.Example: 他每天晚上直播。 tā měitiān wǎnshang zhíbō: He streams every night
cards.Notes: 直 direct + 播 broadcast = broadcast directly, live

cards.Example: 他们交往一年了。 tāmen jiāowǎng yì nián le: They've been dating a year
cards.Notes: 交 cross, exchange + 往 go towards = go back and forth with someone

cards.Example: 我爸爸退休了。 wǒ bàba tuìxiū le: My dad retired
cards.Notes: 退 withdraw + 休 rest (人 leaning on 木 tree) = withdraw and rest

cards.Example: 老师批评了他。 lǎoshī pīpíng le tā: The teacher scolded him
cards.Notes: 批 comment + 评 judge = comment and judge, criticize
